---
name: Design proposal
about: Propose an in-scope engineering change before implementation
title: ""
---

## Problem and scope

Which implemented workflow or plan milestone does this serve? Why is the existing
behavior insufficient? State what is explicitly out of scope.

## Contract and trade-offs

Frames/units, inputs/outputs, ownership, failure/accounting behavior, deterministic
ordering and schema compatibility. Explain alternatives and dependency costs.

## Verification and claims

Independent authored tests, acceptance gates fixed before results, evidence to
retain and claims that the change does not establish. Do not propose real sensor
calibration, safety or production claims without independent evidence.
